sayLines.text: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Cliffhanger is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

🔥 Li takes up a brand and Pamela follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. Cliffhanger was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)

grants.why: The feast is warm and good — but your reactor hums its steady note underneath, and the fire never catches. 1.25x, always, is all there is. (Feast buff refused:
